verdict.rationale: Formant is a robot fleet operations platform, so integrating robotics foundation models is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents no tooling for plugging vision-language-action or foundation models into a robot's autonomy stack. What it does show is adjacent and earns no credit: an AI assistant for dashboards, ML-driven task recommendations, a general claim of connecting AI and robots, and agent SDKs for telemetry and commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can integrate vision-language-action or robotics foundation models into my robot's autonomy stack through supported tooling
